name: RuntimeTypeInspector.js
description: Checking JSDoc types at runtime for high-quality types - Trust is good, control is better.

paragraphs: RuntimeTypeInspector.js alongside JSDoc is a powerful tool which works in tandem with Babel.js and TypeScript to generate type-asserting JavaScript files. Assertion code is injected into debug builds to perform runtime type checking of each function and method at runtime - a step which is required beyond pure static typing to help emerge the Incident Management Lifecycle.
RuntimeTypeInspector.js is supporting Identify and Respond of the IML.

This technology is critical because it provides developers with an organized method to ensure type safety with runtime type issue reports while improving code organization, type safety and documentation - making it easier for other developers to understand the code and enforce good coding standards.
features: Resolve - once the issue is cognized it's resolvable
Learn - clarify the issue for yourself and share with others
